text_to_speech: My name is Keith Ammon. I moved to New Hampshire in 2009 from the suburbs of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Soon after I moved, I joined the board of the New Hampshire Liberty Alliance as the Membership Director, and I served a term on that board. And then following that, I was elected to the school board in my town and served a term in that capacity, and then following that, I got elected to State Representative for Hillsborough District 40, which covers four towns in southern central New Hampshire. Here in the Free State Project, we have people moving here and committing basically all their free time—after they earn a living to pay for their necessities—the rest of their free time is spent advancing liberty, and it’s not just a temporary thing, this a long-term goal that we’re advancing year by year. The reason why I believe, and why I would like if other people would support the Free State Project with financial donations, is because I think it’s the best value for your charitable dollars when it comes to advancing the cause of liberty. We’re using our free time and our own resources to advance the cause of liberty and the more that we can advertise and recruit, the more effective that we are in what we’re doing, so I would appreciate any donations that people are willing to give. In my opinion, this is really the last best hope for liberty. We’re going to create a free society here in New Hampshire and show the rest of the world and the rest of the country how it’s done.

youtube_description:
http://freest.at/KeithAmmon — Representative Keith Ammon is serving at the New Hampshire House of Representatives, representing Hillsborough District 40, which covers four towns. Keith is the Political Director on the New Hampshire Liberty Alliance board of directors [http://NHliberty.org]. Keith moved to NH from PA as part of the Free State Project in 2009.

The Free State Project is a revolutionary social movement to concentrate 20,000 liberty activists in New Hampshire. We successfully reached our goal of 20,000 signers on February 3, 2016, which officially "Triggered The Move." This makes the Free State Project the most successful intentional migration movement in American history. 

Come to the Free State Project's two big annual events & see what we're about!
* New Hampshire Liberty Forum, with keynote address from Edward Snowden (Feb 18-21, 2016): http://NHLibertyForum.com
* PorcFest XIII, a weeklong camp-out with 2,000 liberty-lovers (June 19-26, 2016): http://PorcFest.com

For more information, or better yet, to sign up and make history with us, visit http://FreeStateProject.org
